title: Supporting the success of scientific and digital projects
introduction: My name is Vivien PRAUD WALTER, and I am a multidisciplinary project manager who has led projects ranging from scientific research and web development to the construction of imaging platforms. This website presents my work across these fields, allowing you to discover what I do.
